findings.message: `p.datehour BETWEEN '2026-09-29' AND '2026-09-30'` compares TIMESTAMP `p.datehour` with a date, which means midnight UTC, so the range ends at the start of its last day and leaves out the rest of it.
findings.fix: Use a half-open range: `p.datehour >= '2026-09-29' AND p.datehour < '2026-10-01'`.
